answer_1.quote: The task of Chinese spelling correction (CSC) aims to correct each incorrect character in a sentence ... Our approach ... outputs a sentence of the same length, denoted as y …
answer_1.outputs: Corrected sentence strings (character‑level corrections) matching the input length

answer_2.quote: We use the sentence-level correction F1 (S-F) as the main evaluation metric. Besides, we also report character-level correction F1 (C-F) and sentence-level false positive rate (FPR)... In ASR error correction we also report Character Error Rate (CER) and Character Error Rate Reduction (CERR).
